summary: Registration hero with the Nov 27 opening, three steps for new families, division chart with a Baseball/Softball switch, Challenger card with its contact, Fall Ball 2026 scoreboard, then the sign-up list.

sources.fact: Challenger Division is adaptive baseball for players with physical and intellectual challenges, ages 4 to 18 (up to 22 if still in school); questions to vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org.
Fall Ball 2026 had 8 divisions: Tee Ball (co-ed); Baseball Coach Pitch, AA, Minors, Majors; Softball Minors B, Minors A, Majors.
Fall Ball 2026 games ran Sep 12 through Oct 31.
